brief.headline: Secure a second source before pushing price — Berry is in the distress zone (-199.2% profit, 220.44x debt) and we're 7.21% of their sales.

priceAsk.summary: Ask them to match the ₹1.62/NOS price we already pay Bprex for the LDPE bottle, cutting their ₹1.69/NOS by 4.3%.
priceAsk.target: ₹1.62/NOS for LDPE BOTTLE 5ML WHITE OPAQUE, saving us ₹3.37 L/year
priceAsk.basis: We already pay Bprex Pharma Packaging India (P) Limited ₹1.62/NOS for the same bottle. Berry charges ₹1.69/NOS — a 4.3% gap. They're a trader (100.0% traded revenue), so their price carries a reseller margin; push them to the maker's price or bring Bprex in as the main source.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Offer to pay them 15 days faster (15 days instead of 30) in exchange for a roughly 3% price cut.
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Paying 15 days faster ties up ₹3.34 L of our cash, but their cash is stuck for 335d (far longer than the 70d typical for similar firms), so early payment is worth about 2.77% to them — trade it for a matching price cut.

brief.financialLeverage: Berry is in serious trouble: they lost ₹-22.50 Cr in FY2023-24 (keeping -199.2% of every ₹100 they sell, versus 2.3% at similar firms), owe 220.44x their own cash, and score 1/10 on money-health. Their distress-zone score is -0.18. Yet we're a big customer — our ₹81.39 L is 7.21% of their ₹11.29 Cr revenue — so they can't afford to lose us. But pushing too hard on price could tip them over and kill our supply. Lead with supply-security: tell them we're qualifying a second source (Manjushree or Mold-Tek) and will split the business unless they match Bprex's ₹1.62/NOS. Don't squeeze beyond that — keep them viable enough to deliver.

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter (₹2569.83 Cr revenue, B 65/100 health) — makes pharma bottles, caps, preforms in-house. Strong second-source candidate; get an RFQ out this month.

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed, profitable rigid-plastic leader (pails, containers, pharma packaging) — robust alternate for bottles and closures.

alternates.name: Bprex Pharma Packaging India (P) Limited
alternates.why: Already our supplier for the same LDPE bottle at ₹1.62/NOS (4.3% cheaper than Berry) — expand volume with them if Berry won't match.

risks: Berry is in the distress zone (Altman Z -0.18, D 0/100 health) — pushing too hard could break them and kill our supply mid-year.
They're 100.0% a trader, so we're paying a middleman margin; going direct to a maker (Manjushree, Mold-Tek) long-term will cut 10–15%.
Our ₹81.39 L is 7.21% of their revenue — if we pull out fast, they may not survive to fulfill open POs; stage any shift over two quarters.
They take 226d to pay their own suppliers (vs 41d peer median) and collect in 254d — a sign of severe cash stress; watch for late deliveries or quality shortcuts.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We value the relationship, but we're paying ₹1.69 while Bprex delivers the same bottle at ₹1.62 — we need you at that price to keep the full ₹81 lakh annual business with you.
